intended_use: Labeled hypothetical result projection and figure layout for discussion; no evidence of empirical method superiority.
summary_std: Sample SD across five seeds, ddof=1; not a confidence interval or empirical benchmark uncertainty.

metric_definitions.variance_reduction: 1-Var(corrected invariant score difference)/Var(raw invariant score difference)
metric_definitions.r2: 1-sum(corrected invariant difference^2)/sum((raw invariant difference-mean(raw invariant difference))^2)
metric_definitions.evidence_retention: sum((right_label-left_label)*corrected_flip_difference)/sum((right_label-left_label)*raw_flip_difference); closer to 1 is preferable, not larger without limit
metric_definitions.native_accuracy: mean(predicted_label==label) on a separate n=1500 native sample
metric_definitions.path_accuracy: MEGA-style only: fraction of 200 fixed synthetic length-six paths with all six sampled native nodes correct; not real decision-tree execution
metric_definitions.invariant_pair_accuracy: fraction with both invariant pair sides correct
metric_definitions.flip_pair_accuracy: fraction with both truth-flipping pair sides correct

recommended_main_direction: Smaller invariant_rms, larger variance_reduction/R2, evidence_retention closer to 1, smaller cf_correction_over_ap_rms; accuracy is a separate check.
paths: MEGA-style: 200 fixed synthetic length-six paths sampled with replacement from the same 1500 native nodes; every method uses identical path indices. This does not simulate a real decision-tree controller. NLI/syllogism paths are not applicable.
